name: google-drive-mcp
description: Google Drive cartridge -- full-query search (incl. shared drives), export-aware content reading, folder listing, metadata, permissions listing and granting, copy, create with content, update content, move, rename, reversible trash/restore (no permanent delete by design), revision history, format export, storage quota, and shared-drive enumeration via the Google Drive API v3

safety.no_permanent_delete: This cartridge deliberately exposes only reversible trash/restore. files.delete (permanent, unrecoverable) is not implemented; recovery is always possible via gdrive_restore or the Drive UI bin.

tools.name: gdrive_search
tools.description: Search Drive with the full files.list query language (q=), e.g. "name contains 'report' and mimeType='application/pdf' and modifiedTime > '2026-01-01'". Supports shared drives, ordering, and pagination

query.description: Drive query language expression (https://developers.google.com/drive/api/guides/search-files). Empty string lists everything visible

page_token.description: Token from a previous page's nextPageToken

tools.name: gdrive_read_content
tools.description: Read a file's content. Google-native files are exported (Docs->text/markdown, Sheets->CSV, Slides->plain text) automatically; regular files are downloaded as text. Size-capped

prefer_markdown.description: Export Google Docs as Markdown instead of plain text (default true)

max_bytes.description: Refuse to return more than this many bytes (default 1048576)

tools.name: gdrive_export
tools.description: Export a Google-native file to an explicit MIME type (e.g. application/pdf, text/markdown, text/csv, docx). Returns base64 for binary types

file_id.description: Drive file ID of a Google-native file

tools.name: gdrive_get_metadata
tools.description: Full metadata for one file: name, mimeType, size, owners, parents, timestamps, sharing state, webViewLink, capabilities

tools.name: gdrive_list_recent
tools.description: Most recently modified files visible to the user

tools.name: gdrive_list_folder
tools.description: List the direct children of a folder (files and subfolders), with pagination

folder_id.description: Folder ID ('root' for My Drive root)

tools.name: gdrive_get_permissions
tools.description: List who has access to a file and at what role

tools.name: gdrive_share
tools.description: Grant a user, group, domain, or anyone a role on a file. Sends notification email only if asked

role.description: Role to grant (owner transfers are deliberately not supported)

tools.name: gdrive_copy
tools.description: Copy a file, optionally into a different folder and/or with a new name

parent_folder_id.description: Destination folder ID (default: same as source)

tools.name: gdrive_create_file
tools.description: Create a file or folder. For files, optional inline text content is uploaded in the same call (multipart)

mime_type.description: MIME type; use application/vnd.google-apps.folder for a folder, application/vnd.google-apps.document to create a Google Doc from the content (default text/plain)

content.description: Inline text content for files (omit for folders)

tools.name: gdrive_update_content
tools.description: Replace a file's content with new text (media upload). Metadata unchanged

tools.name: gdrive_move
tools.description: Move a file to a different folder (removes from current parents, adds the new one)

tools.name: gdrive_trash
tools.description: Move a file to the bin (REVERSIBLE -- restore with gdrive_restore). Permanent deletion is deliberately not offered by this cartridge

tools.name: gdrive_restore
tools.description: Restore a file from the bin

tools.name: gdrive_list_revisions
tools.description: Revision history for a file: who modified it and when, with export links where available

tools.name: gdrive_storage_quota
tools.description: The account's storage quota: limit, total usage, usage in Drive vs Trash

tools.name: gdrive_list_shared_drives
tools.description: Enumerate shared drives the user can access
